intro.headline: Reliable. Scalable. Fast. Powerful.
intro.description:
Unlock the True Value of Your Site—our drone-enabled volumetric surveys provide precise, timely measurements that drive smarter planning, resource management, and project efficiency. By capturing high-resolution 3D data and calculating accurate stockpile volumes, cut/fill quantities, and site balances, we reduce manual errors and eliminate the guesswork. Whether you’re managing earthworks, mining operations, or material inventory, our surveys deliver the geospatial clarity you need to make informed decisions. With SmartGrid, precision from above becomes your foundation for productivity below. 

 Smartgrid Surveying is your trusted surveying partner!

maximizeProductivity.headline: Maximize Productivity. Minimize Guesswork.
maximizeProductivity.description: Leverage SmartGrid's cutting-edge drone volume surveys to make faster, smarter decisions on site. Let data lead the way to profitability.

items.title: Stockpile Volume Measurement
items.description: Quick and safe volumetric data for materials like gravel, sand, and coal — reducing the need for manual measurement and risk.

items.title: Quarry and Mine Monitoring
items.description: Track cut/fill volumes and changes over time with high-resolution terrain data captured from above.

items.title: Earthworks Progress Tracking
items.description: Compare as-built models against designs to monitor progress and confirm excavation volumes with centimeter-level accuracy.

items.title: Cut and Fill Calculations
items.description: Generate detailed 3D models to determine how much material needs to be removed or added—ideal for grading and leveling.

items.title: Historical Comparison and Audits
items.description: Compare datasets over time for performance reviews, billing verification, and regulatory compliance.
